scope: Currently referenced active Word-embedded photos; PDF photos extracted with the same process are kept as a separately identified additional group. Archived owners excluded.

rules.proof: Asset filename OR per-image source-index origin OR live Photo sheet origin. PDF filename + sheet PDF provenance overrides mislabeled anna_word_embedded. A tour's Word-based text alone does not establish photo provenance.
rules.enhanced: exact current asset must match method:gpt-image enhancement output; direct S3 upload or WebP conversion is not enhancement
rules.order: Photo sheet row order, unique source; batchSize=10
rules.unconfirmed: no canonical GPT Image evidence means NEEDS_REPLACEMENT; does not prove no historical tool invocation
